items.source: The collector uses AotServices to discover implementations of TypeCollector.TypeCollectorFilters so that components using TypeCollector can contribute their own filtering logic to exclude types, fields, and methods from being inspected.
items.translation: 收集器使用AotServices来发现TypeCollector.TypeCollectorFilters的实现，以便使用TypeCollector的组件能够贡献自己的过滤逻辑，以排除对类型、字段和方法的检查。

items.source: Type collection can be customized by providing filters that stop introspection when encountering a Predicate that returns false. Filters are combined so that multiple filters can be taken into account. A type/field/method must pass all filters to be considered for further inspection.
items.translation: 可以通过提供过滤器来自定义类型收集，这些过滤器在遇到返回 false 的 Predicate 时停止内省。过滤器会 组合，以便考虑多个过滤器。类型、字段或方法必须通过所有过滤器才会被进一步检查。

items.source:
Type inspection walks through all class members (fields, methods, constructors) and introspects those for additional
types that are part of the domain model.
items.translation: 类型检查会遍历所有类成员（字段、方法和构造函数），并内省这些成员以查找属于领域模型的额外类型。

items.source: Container for reachable types starting from a set of root types.
items.translation: 从一组根类型开始可达类型的容器。

items.source:
Strategy interface providing predicates to filter types, fields, and methods from being introspected and
contributed to AOT processing.
items.translation: 提供谓词以过滤类型、字段和方法，防止其被内省并贡献给 AOT 处理的策略接口。
